title: SirBilby's Vanilla+
description: SirBilby's carefully compiled modpack providing a highly-optimised Vanilla+ experience
body: I've spent the last couple of years choosing mods from modrinth that enhance my survival gameplay. Containing all optimisation mods from Fabulously Optimised, plus a bunch of other Vanilla+ mods such as Litematica, Worldedit, Axiom and Replaymod/Flashback, this pack is perfect for both personal playing and content creation, all while boosting your FPS as much as possible!
